<title level="1" right="Condition">[Helpful](/Conditions.aspx?ID=78)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 444

This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC. A creature that is helpful to a character wishes to actively aid that character. It will accept reasonable [Requests](/Actions.aspx?ID=51) from that character, as long as such requests aren't at the expense of the helpful creature's goals or quality of life. If the character (or one of their allies) uses a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against the creature, the creature gains a worse attitude condition depending on the severity of the hostile action, as determined by the GM.
name: Helpful
